hero_title: Free for All Trail Creators and Explorers
hero_description_1: Trail Creators: Design your own trails with checkpoints, quizzes, and interactive content to engage participants.
hero_description_2: Explorers: Scan, explore, and complete trails to unlock achievements and earn personalized certificates.
how_step_1: Log in or create an account using a personal email.
how_step_2: Go to the trail, scan the QR code, and start your journey.
how_step_3: Answer trail-related questions as you explore.
how_step_4: Successfully finish and get your personalized certificate!
testimonials: Many Explorers & Trail Creators Recommend AVA Trail
testimonial_1: AVA Trail makes exploring so much more engaging! Scanning a QR code to unlock information along the way adds an interactive touch to every hike.
testimonial_2: As a creator, I love how AVA Trail allows me to create custom trails with quizzes. It transforms outdoor learning into an exciting, hands-on experience. They don't just walk-they explore, learn, and earn rewards!
testimonial_3: I was amazed by how easy AVA Trail is to use. The certificate at the end makes it even more rewarding!
footer_description: A smart way to explore trails with real-time QR scanning.
